For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy markets itself as a simple solution for selling digital products, offering features like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-explained-digital-8|COREMERCH guide to automated]] delivery and analytics. However, it excludes users in many countries, limiting access for a large portion of creators. Alternatives such as Gumroad also fall short due to similar restrictions. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure provided by COREMERCH enables creators to build fully autonomous online stores, using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments for seamless transactions, without the need for traditional payment processors. This empowers users to own their infrastructure and avoid reliance on platforms that impose geographical limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Most conventional platforms like Lemon Squeezy and PayPal have rigid policies that exclude creators in specific countries due to regulatory compliance and risk factors. This often leaves creators without viable options for selling their digital products. In contrast, COREMERCH’s infrastructure is designed to function independently of such restrictions. By leveraging decentralized payment systems like NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing a robust alternative that doesn't discriminate based on location. This means that irrespective of the creator's country, they can establish their online store and access global markets.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing through Lemon Squeezy and PayPal can be slow, especially when dealing with suspended accounts or disputes, which can freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse. Furthermore, their fees can accumulate quickly, especially for creators selling low-priced digital goods. By utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, creators can enjoy low transaction fees of just 0.5% through NOWPayments, with instant payment confirmation via cryptocurrencies. This not only speeds up cash flow but also significantly reduces operational costs, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings.
Sovereign infrastructure means you own your online store, not a platform.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital assets and customer data is a critical concern for many digital creators. Platforms like Lemon Squeezy and PayPal maintain control over sensitive information, which can lead to complications if account suspensions occur. COREMERCH ensures that once the infrastructure is deployed, the creator owns everything—there are no subscriptions or hidden fees. Each deployment includes automated product delivery and payment verification, providing a seamless experience for buyers and sellers alike. This level of ownership is essential for creators looking to build sustainable businesses without the threat of losing access to their platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on the specific needs of the creator. For those looking for a quick solution with essential features, the Sovereign Starter Stack at $97 is a solid entry point. However, for those needing advanced capabilities, the Edge Commerce Stack at $197 provides a complete solution with five products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and 30 days of support. Assess your needs carefully—if you anticipate scaling, opting for comprehensive architecture from the outset can save time and hassle down the line.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the risk of account suspensions that freeze funds for months.

With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) available, you can deploy a full-fledged online store that meets all your digital selling needs. Check out our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
